body.statement:
If the independently specified oracle-instance \(\mathsf X_{\mathrm{phys}}=(x_{\mathrm{str}},\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}})\) is feasible, then the minimum defining \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is attained by the lexicographically first canonical switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\).  Exhaustive enumeration of switching certificates of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), with one cached oracle reply per distinct protocol, outputs \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), its protocol masks, exact \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\)-bit slice labels, source masks, \(M\)-bit branch-ownership masks, and one finite concrete restriction transcript per owned branch.  Its running time is
\[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}),
\]
where \(N_{\mathcal O}\) charges every issued protocol query and every returned law-handle, support-index header, and support-table bit.  The verifier executes complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) on the decoded oracle-backed source collection.  No polynomial certificate bound or bounded-treewidth runtime is claimed.
body.justification: The theorem retains exact cost optimization over the sound switching class and charges every source-law and support access.
body.gap: Ordinary intervention design and fixed-source identification do not optimize branch-indexed SELECT--RAND--CTF-RAND--READ acquisitions.
body.consumer: Counterfactual structural causal bandits can compare exact attainable reward-law acquisition costs.
body.proof_tex:
By the canonical switching-certificate lemma, feasibility supplies at least one accepted canonical certificate of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), and the minimum over that finite set equals the infimum in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ optimal\ acquisition\ cost}\).  Enumerate all binary strings of lengths \(0,1,\ldots,B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) in lexicographic order.  Their number is
\[
 \sum_{r=0}^{B_{\mathrm{sw}}}2^r
 =2^{B_{\mathrm{sw}}+1}-1.                                                       \tag{6}
\]
For each string, apply the total parser in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ operational\ acceptance}\).  Malformed strings are rejected.  For a parsed certificate, verify the ownership partition of the explicitly enumerated \(M\) branches, protocol legality, catalogue values, the positive support of each used conditioning event, measured ancestry, each concrete restriction transcript, and the complete \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run.  Cache \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) under the \(m\)-bit mask \(S\); thus every distinct queried protocol is charged once, and all reply bits read by the execution are included in \(N_{\mathcal O}\).

Each local graph or mask operation is polynomial in \(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Any exhaustive subsearch of the complete finite run ranges over objects encoded by the candidate string or over the \(M\) explicit branches, and is bounded by \(2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}\).  Multiplying this bound by (6), and accounting linearly for the oracle payload actually read, gives
\[
 2^{O(B_{\mathrm{sw}})}
 \operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+B_{\mathrm{sw}}+N_{\mathcal O}).          \tag{7}
\]

For every accepted candidate compute
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 =\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
\]
using exact binary-rational arithmetic, keep the least value, and retain the lexicographically first string on a tie.  The canonical-bound lemma proves that no longer certificate and no accepting generic acquisition has smaller cost.  Therefore the retained string is \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), its cost is \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\), and decoding its fixed-width masks and self-delimiting transcripts gives exactly the asserted output.
